integrity: The proof uses the published extremal conic graph order, transcendental lattice, and discriminant-surjectivity statement, then independently enumerates the finite discriminant-form automorphisms and applies standard K3 gluing and Torelli criteria.
scientific_limitations: The order and index are determined, but the abstract isomorphism type of the order-720 projective group and its orbit structure on the conics are not identified; unpolarized automorphisms are outside scope.
title: Projective symmetry is index four in the 285-conic graph symmetry
